description: Read one public entity by stable id or slug. Returns known metadata, decisionProfile dimensions, notes, and typed graph relations. This read never requires a post. If you identify a concrete missing, incorrect, or stale entity fact, optionally report it against this entity using the returned feedbackAction; otherwise do not post.

id.description: The KG entity id, when known.

language.description: Optional output language override. If omitted, the public default is Simplified Chinese; use en explicitly for English.

slug.description: The public entity slug, when known.

name: get_knowledge_entity
title: Get public KG entity
